title: GeneReg-Eval inference rule catalog v1
scope: Abstract-grounded TF-to-target transcriptional relation reasoning. This catalog describes inference patterns, not an exhaustive list of experimental assays.
primary_selection_policy: When more than one rule applies, final_relation.primary_rule_application_id must identify the highest-priority applicable rule. GRR-001 and GRR-010 are fallback-only.

minimum_requirements: The source explicitly states the named TF-to-Target transcriptional relation.
exclusions: Do not invent an experiment absent from the source.

minimum_requirements: Loss or reduction of the named TF is explicit.
exclusions: Target protein abundance alone without transcriptional context.
Intervention against a non-unique family or complex.

minimum_requirements: Loss or reduction of the named TF is explicit.
exclusions: Target protein abundance alone without transcriptional context.
Intervention against a non-unique family or complex.

minimum_requirements: Gain or increase of the named TF is explicit.
exclusions: Target protein abundance alone without transcriptional context.

minimum_requirements: Gain or increase of the named TF is explicit.
exclusions: Target protein abundance alone without transcriptional context.

minimum_requirements: The named TF is linked to a functional change in the named Target promoter or reporter.
exclusions: Promoter occupancy without a functional output.

minimum_requirements: Binding/occupancy and a functional consequence for the same Target are linked in the source.
A TF-linked Target binding site is functionally perturbed and Target promoter/transcription output changes.
The source explicitly identifies the named TF as a component of the functional complex.
The complex is linked to Target transcriptional output.
exclusions: Complex or A/B expression whose component identity is unresolved; route those to REVIEW.

minimum_requirements: A functional TF-to-Target transcriptional relation is explicit but direction is not established.
exclusions: Binding, association, correlation, or PPI alone.

global_exclusions: Binding, ChIP, occupancy, EMSA, correlation, association, pathway co-occurrence, or protein interaction alone are not positive inference rules.
A Target protein function is not regulation of the Target gene.
Evidence for Target-to-TF does not support TF-to-Target.
Unresolved species, family, complex, fusion, or A/B identity routes to REVIEW rather than a new rule.
